cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

mechanism: A copies an inquiry ritual without understanding it, then insists B incriminate themselves before A supplies an account.
confusable: D06 merely probes knowledge; D16 demands B's own responsibility first. S04 must be a visible mistaken borrowed method.
seedUse: D16-a keeps demanding a more incriminating detail after B's first admission.
